lines.en: Why did Jenny want to leave the wedding reception?
lines.cn: 为什么珍妮想离开婚礼现场呢？

lines.en: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
lines.cn: 杰里米·汉普登拥有很多朋友，在聚会上非常受欢迎。

lines.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour--everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
lines.cn: 大家都很欣赏他的幽默感——当然，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮之外。

lines.en: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
lines.cn: 最近，杰里米的一位密友请求他在一场婚礼招待会上发表演讲。

lines.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
lines.cn: 这正是杰里米喜欢的东西。

lines.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
lines.cn: 他仔细准备了演讲稿，然后和珍妮一起参加了婚礼。

lines.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
lines.cn: 他在演讲中穿插了许多有趣的故事，当然，这次演讲非常成功。

lines.en: As soon as he had finished Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
lines.cn: 他刚说完，珍妮就告诉他她想回家了。

lines.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
lines.cn: 杰里米对此感到有些失望，但他还是按照女儿的要求做了。

lines.en: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
lines.cn: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢那场演讲。

lines.en: To his surprise she said she hadn't.
lines.cn: 令他惊讶的是，她说她并没有（做某件事）。

lines.en: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
lines.cn: 杰里米问她为什么会有这样的反应，她回答说她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他！
